description: A nursing supervisor must finalize overnight cross-coverage for the intensive care unit and cardiac step-down unit during a Saturday night staffing shortage, with input from the ICU charge nurse, staffing office, and nurse educator.

shared_context.S1: Saturday overnight coverage runs from 19:00 to 07:00 for the intensive care unit and the cardiac step-down unit.
shared_context.S2: One additional float RN is available for part of the overnight period, but the two units also have an open coverage gap.
shared_context.S3: Elena, the nursing supervisor, makes the binding overnight coverage assignment.
shared_context.S4: The ICU and cardiac step-down units share a pool of nurses who may be reassigned when their competencies and scheduled hours permit.
shared_context.S5: As part of the standard 17:00 staffing huddle, Elena checks with the ICU charge nurse, staffing office, and nurse educator before publishing the overnight assignment.

PF1.text: From 23:00 to 07:00, the ICU will have two patients requiring continuous one-to-one observation, and its scheduled nurses cannot cover both patients; step-down RN Morgan is ventilator-competent and can be reassigned to the ICU for that exact period.

PF2.text: The only available supplemental RN is Lee, who is confirmed for 23:00-07:00 and cannot start before 23:00; Lee must be assigned to the cardiac step-down unit because that is the remaining uncovered assignment.

PF3.text: Lee's current validation covers telemetry and routine IV medications but not ventilator management, so Lee cannot be assigned to the ICU; the published plan must include an educator competency check at 22:45 before Lee begins step-down coverage.

acceptance_conditions: Morgan must be reassigned from cardiac step-down to the ICU.
Lee must be assigned as the supplemental cardiac step-down RN.
Both coverage assignments must run from 23:00 to 07:00.
A competency check for Lee must be scheduled at 22:45 before step-down coverage begins.
The ICU observation requirement must be cited as justification for the reassignment.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'competency_check' and c['target'] == 'Lee' and c['detail'] == '22:45 before step-down coverage' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The two one-to-one ICU observation needs from 23:00 to 07:00 require cross-unit reassignment, and Morgan's ventilator competency fixes Morgan as the ICU reassignee.
Lee's only available shift is exactly 23:00-07:00, which fixes both the supplemental step-down assignment and the coverage window.
Lee's lack of ventilator validation rules out assigning Lee to the ICU and requires a competency check at exactly 22:45 before Lee covers step-down.
